title: FTSE 100 rises to 10217; banks and tech stocks lead gains
body: The FTSE 100 index gained 0.67% today, with HSBC, NatWest, and Barclays leading the charge in the financial sector.

title: FCA launches review into long-term impact of AI on retail financial services
body: The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has started a review to consider how artificial intelligence will evolve by 2030 and its effects on consumers and firms.

title: UBS forecasts Bank of England interest rate cuts in February and April
body: UBS analysts expect the BoE to cut interest rates twice more in 2026, targeting a terminal rate of 3.25%.

title: Lloyds Banking Group kicks off full-year results season
body: Lloyds Banking Group has begun the full-year earnings season for major UK banks, with investors focusing on net interest margins and loan growth outlook for 2026.

title: JD Wetherspoon warns fiscal 2026 profit could fall
body: Pub giant JD Wetherspoon has issued a cautious outlook, warning that profits for the 2026 fiscal year might be lower than previously estimated due to rising labor costs.

title: Shell and AstraZeneca prepare to report Q4 earnings
body: Energy giant Shell and pharmaceutical leader AstraZeneca are both scheduled to report their fourth-quarter 2025 results next week, with analysts expecting strong cash flows from Shell.

title: Polar Capital Global Financials Trust declares 2.55p dividend
body: Polar Capital Global Financials Trust Plc has declared an interim dividend of 2.55 pence per share, payable in late February to registered shareholders.

title: Unilever and GSK set to report half-year results
body: Consumer goods firm Unilever and pharma giant GSK are expected to provide updates on their performance and 2026 guidance in the coming days.
